text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Taiki Shuttle was,
I decided to take her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I shall take it easy and rest today.
Ohhh... I'm sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What!? Where are we!?
Wait, are those... the Three Goddesses!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! So happy to see you!
Please, let's hug!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh~, don't be shy, please!
Though that face is so cute too, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's all become friends!
Tonight, you're partying with us too!!

Hearing Taiki Shuttle's words, the Three Goddesses seemed to smile.
In that moment, a dazzling light filled the surroundings—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, where are the Three Goddesses?
We were just hugging a moment ago—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's too bad. But it was a good dream!
I feel like something lucky is going to happen!

Perhaps blessed by the Three Goddesses, Taiki Shuttle regained her usual energy
and left the nurse's office with a light spring in her step.

Perhaps Taiki Shuttle's voice didn't reach them, for the Three Goddesses departed somewhere.
In that moment, a dazzling light filled the surroundings—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the person I tried to hug in my dream
vanished into thin air! It's magic!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hah... if I go back to sleep, maybe I can see them again?
Okay, time for round two! Eyes closed—
Taiki Shuttle's excitement continued, and unable to settle down to sleep afterward, she couldn't get enough rest.
